thesis: Leading 3D content creation platform with ~70% mobile game market share, now in the middle of a credible turnaround under CEO Matt Bromberg. The new Vector AI-powered advertising and monetization platform is driving a rebuild of the 'Grow Solutions' business, a strong (pre-announced) Q1 2026 helped shares recover ~75% off the February/March lows, and TTM revenue has reaccelerated to +7.6%. The Unity 7 authoring roadmap unveiled at Unite Seoul reinforces Create Solutions leadership. With ~$2B cash, positive free cash flow, and a Buy consensus implying ~16% upside, the risk/reward has improved. Still GAAP-unprofitable with heavy stock-based compensation (~5% annual dilution) and Unreal Engine competition, so the upgrade to SPEC. BUY reflects a positive but high-beta, speculative thesis.

drivers: Vector AI ad/monetization platform reaccelerates Grow Solutions and drives sustained double-digit revenue growth
Q2 2026 beat confirms turnaround; developer trust and pricing model fully stabilize
Unity 7 authoring platform extends Create Solutions mobile-engine leadership and expands TAM
Operating leverage pushes the company toward GAAP profitability with 25%+ EBITDA margins
Multiple re-rates as the market rewards a durable growth and margin story under new leadership

base_case.assumptions: Grow Solutions rebuild on Vector delivers steady high-single to low-double-digit revenue growth; margins expand toward 20% EBITDA with FCF staying positive; developer relations and pricing remain stable; GAAP profitability stays elusive near term but the trajectory supports a modest re-rating in line with the ~$35.45 analyst consensus.

risks: Vector ramp disappoints and Grow Solutions revenue stalls
Unreal Engine keeps taking share, especially in high-end and AAA gaming
Developer trust never fully recovers from the 2023 Runtime Fee controversy
Goodwill/impairment risk forces write-downs and pressures reported results
Persistent GAAP losses and ~5% annual SBC dilution weigh on the high-beta (2.05) stock

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — mobile-game industry checks point to a likely beat; watch Grow reacceleration and margin progress
Vector AI platform ramp and Grow Solutions rebuild metrics (ad monetization, developer adoption)
Unity 7 next-generation authoring platform rollout following the Unite Seoul roadmap unveiling
Developer-trust and pricing-model stabilization after the Runtime Fee reset

key_risks: GAAP losses persist (TTM net income -$672.73M, elevated by charges/SBC) despite positive FCF
Vector/Grow rebuild execution risk — turnaround still early and dependent on ad-market strength
Epic's Unreal Engine 5 competition, free below $1M revenue, pressures high-end and AAA share
Heavy stock-based compensation dilutes shareholders ~5% annually
Goodwill/impairment risk and high beta (2.05) make the stock volatile and speculative
